tei:div.tei:p: "$ (115)༄༅/ rdzogs pa chen po gsang ba snying thig ma bu'i bka' srol chu bo gnyis 'dus kyi khrid yig dri med zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(116)na mo gu ru badz+ra sa man+ta bha drā ya// rang byung ye shes kun khyab gdod ma'i mgon// khyad par bdun ldan dbyings snang longs spyod rdzogs// rang bzhin 'gro 'dul sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku// khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs la phyag bgyi'o// zab cing brtag dka' nam mkha' lta bu'i gnas// spang bya gnyen po gnyis ka'i mtha' las grol// su 'phrad 'byung bzhi 'od du dengs byed pa// bstan pa 'od gsal rdo rje rtse mor 'dud// dga' rab la sogs rgya bod rig pa 'dzin// khyad par dri med bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i rje// klong chen rab 'byams ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// rdo rje gzi brjid byang chub bar du bsnyen// bcu bdun rgyud kyi gnyen 'dzin 'khor 'das kyi// dbyings phyug sngags kyi bdag mo ral gcig mas// gnang ba'i skabs stsol 'chad dang nyams len la// bar chad med cing grub pa mthar phyin mdzod// gdod ma'i dbyings su 'khor ba dong sprugs chos// rtog ges (117)ma bslad byin rlabs gzi ma nyams// dri med bshes gnyen thugs kyi thig le ni// kun mkhyen chos rjes bcud du dril ba gang*// gter chen yab sras zhal lung bum bzang las// khyab bdag bla ma'i drin gyis legs thob pa// rang bzos ma bslad gzhan la phan 'dod blos// 'dus gsal lag khrid rim pa bshad par bya// 'dir phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba ma lus pa'i bstan pa thams cad kyi rtse mo// chos thams cad kyi 'khor lo mtha' dag gi yang bcud/ rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam thams cad kyi mthar thug /'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i snying po// yang gsang man ngag gi sde slob dpon chen po bi ma la mi tra'i snying thig ma bu'i bka' srol chu bo gcig 'dres kyi zab khrid 'chad par byed pa la gnyis/ mthun rkyen tshogs pas gdams ngag gi sgrom du gzhug pa dang*/ 'chad bya khrid tshul gyi gdams ngag dngos bshad pa'o// dang po la bzhi/

khrid 'chad pa (118)po slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid/ 'chad yul slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul/ mthun rkyen gyi gzhi bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ a ti bkod pa chen po las// mkhas shing bya ba bral ba dang*// chos nyid don la tshad phebs dang*// 'dod pa'i don la rmongs pa med// gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs pas/ spyir gsang sngags kyi rgyud sde mtha' dag gi don la mkhas shing grub mtha'i dbye ba phyed pa bye brag lam 'di nyid kyi nyams myong drod tshad dang ldan pa man ngag gi don ston pa la mkhas shing chags sdang sogs tshe 'di'i 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba rang bral ba/ rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i rim gnyis kyi nyams len mthar phyin pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chos nyid mngon sum gyi don tshad la phebs pa/ dgongs pas rang rgyud grol cing thugs rjes gzhan rgyud smin nus pa/ gnas lugs kyi don la shes rab zab mos sgro 'dogs chod pa'i ye shes kyis slob mas dris pa'i lan la ma rmongs pa ste/ mtshan nyid de dag dang ldan pa ni bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po zhes bya'o// de las ldog pa'i skyon can bsten du mi rung ba ni/ rgyud rang shar las/ mi shes nga rgyal chen po dang*// blo rmongs tshig phyir 'breng ba dang*// gsang sngags don la mi dgongs dang*// gzhan gyi zhe gcod khengs tshig dang*// log pa'i lam du zhugs pa dang*// dbang gi dkyil 'khor zhal ma mthong*// dam tshig 'chal bar gyur pa dang*// dris pa dag la lan mi 'debs// thos chung nga rgyal che ba ste// slob dpon ma brtags slob ma'i bdud// ces pas skyon de dag dang ldan pa ni thog ma nas bsten par mi bya'o// (119)gnyis pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ rang shar las/ dad pa'i stobs dang brtson 'grus che// shes rab che zhing 'dzin chags med// phu dud che zhing gsang sngags spyod// rtog med sems la g.yeng ba med// dam tshig ldan zhing sgrub la brtson// slob dpon ji skad gsung bzhin byed// ces pas/

bla ma dang gdams ngag la yid rab tu spro zhing don du gnyer ba dang ba'i dad pa/ bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu la ched du gdung bas 'dod pa'i dad pa/ the tshom mi byed pa yid ches kyi dad pa/ nyi tshe ba'i rkyen gyis mi 'phrog pa mthar thug gi dad pa ste byin rlabs 'jug pa'i rgyu tshang ba/ bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la phyi gshol dang thang lhod med pa'i snying stobs kyi dam bca' brtan pa/ gnas lugs zab mo'i don la dpyod pa'i shes rab gsal bas nyams rtogs skye sla ba/ zas gos sogs srid pa'i bde 'byor la 'dzin chags chung ba// bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phu dud che bas byin rlabs 'jug pa'i sgo tshang ba/ gsang sngags kyi lam la the tshom gyi sgro 'dogs chod pas zab mo'i spyod pa la 'jug nus pa/ chags sdang rmongs gsum sogs tha mal gyi rnam rtog la sems mi 'jug pas g.yeng ba dang bral ba/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig gnyer du blangs pa las mi 'da' ba'i dam bca' brtan pa/ zab mo'i lam sgom pa la skyo ngal med cing*/ bla mas ji ltar gsungs pa las mi 'da' ba ste/ mtshan nyid de ldan gyi slob ma nyid 'chad yul du bzung bar bya dgos shing*/ de las ldog pa'i snod skyon can ni/ rang shar las/ bkur bsti phu dud mi byed cing*// gsang sngags 'chal ba spyod (120)pa dang*// rigs rgyud med cing ngang rgyud med// shes rab chung bar gyur pa dang*// bka' drin khyad du gsod pa dang*// don med 'chal bar gyur pa ste// slob ma ma brtags slob dpon dgra// zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i snod min la zab mo'i chos bstan na ḍā ki dam can gyis bka' chad 'bebs shing dngos grub mi thob pa dang sgro skur 'byung bas spang bar bya'o// gsum pa bsten pa'i tshul ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma des kyang nad pas sman pa bsten pa ltar/ 'khor ba'i nad las thar ba'i don du/ lus ngag yid gsum gus pas g.yo zol med par srid zhu dang phu dud bya zhing*/

gru 'dod pas mnyen pa bsten pa ltar 'khor bas 'jigs nas rtag tu ci gsung nyan pa dang*/ tshong pas ded dpon bsten pa ltar thar pa 'dod pas rim gro cher bya/ khyad par du rab sgrub pa'i zhabs tog gis sgrub brgyud kyi bstan pa zin pa/ 'bring lus ngag gi zhabs tog gi sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyong ba/ tha ma zang zing gi yo byad kyis tshogs gnyis kyi bre kha khengs pa gang rung gis cis kyang mnyes pa bsgrub par bya ste/ rang shar las/ de ltar man ngag slob dpon la// rang lus dang ni rin chen rdzas// shin tu dkon pa dag gis bsten// zhes gsungs shing de'i yon tan kyang*/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas la// sna tshogs rin chen spras pa yi// stong gsum gang ba phul bas kyang*// bla ma'i ba spu nyag gcig la// mar gyi thigs pa gcig byugs na// bsod nams brgya phrag char mi phod// ces dang*/ gzhan yang sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa 'dag cing kun gyis mthong (121)na dga' ba dang*/ bsod nams dang 'byor pa 'phel zhing mkha' 'gros stong grogs byed pa dang*// mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad dka' ba med par thob pa ste/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ dngos grub 'dod pa'i dad pa can// dngos grub bla ma mnyes las 'byung*// zhes so// bzhi pa mthun rkyen gyi gzhi bzung ba la bzhi/ gnas/ dus/ yo byad/ grogs so// dang po ni/ klong gsal las/ lung stong gangs khrod ri rtse dur khrod dam// shin tu dben zhing dwangs mtho bsil ba'i sar// skal ldan skyes bu'i nyams len byed pa'i gnas// bsam gtan 'phel zhing brtan pa myur tu thob// ces pas sgrub pa'i gnas spyir yid dang mthun pa/ dgra rkun sogs kyi 'tshe ba med cing skye bo'i rgyu 'grul dang ca co sogs kyi rnam g.yeng chung ba/ sa phyogs bkra shis shing gzhi bdag chos la dkar ba/ bla ma dang mkha' 'gro dang grub thob gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/

gangs ri nags khrod brag ri la sogs pa rang bzhin gyis rig pa dwangs zhing sa phyogs mtho ba/ shar gyi mdangs 'phrogs shing nub kyi zer sdud pa/ zhes nyi ma snga mo 'char zhing phyi mor nub pas nyi tshe ring ba/ chu 'jam zhing nyams dga' ba/ mthun rkyen thams cad rnyed par sla ba'i gnas su bsgrub par bya'o// gnyis pa dus ni/ dus dang tshes grangs gza' skar sogs bzang ba la 'jug dgos shing*/ khyad par thod rgal bsgom pa'i dus ni/ dbyar ma ston dang dgun chung dpyid kyi dus/ zer gnyis dus ni mchog tu bshad pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ dus der bsil drod snyoms pa'i (122)dbang shes byings rmugs kyi rkyen nyung zhing*/ bye brag 'char nub kyi zer gnyis te ye shes 'char ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bas ngo sprod kyi dus su bshad pa'i phyir de dang bstun par bya'o// gsum pa yo byad ni/ 'tsho ba'i yo byad zas skom dang gos stan/ bsten pa'i yo byad dam rdzas/ mkho ba'i yo byad rdo rje dang dril bu sogs/ mthun pa'i yo byad sman dang rten 'brel gyi rdzas/ khyad par gyi yo byad dbang yon dang gtor tshogs kyi rgyu la sogs pa mdor na gang gi phyir yang gnas skabs de dag tu brel mi dgos pa gong du 'tshogs par bya ste/ phyag rten me tog dbang yon gtor tshogs rgyu// nyams len dus su khams kyi rten so btsal// mthun pa'i yo byad kun dang ldan par bya// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa grogs ni/ zab lam sgom pa'i nyams myong can nam min kyang rgyud zhi dul dang ldan cing dam tshig gtsang ba/ dag snang 'byongs shing nyon mongs shas chung ba/ brtse sems che bas mthun rkyen sbyor ba la skyo ngal med pa nyid bsten par bya ba klong gsal las gsungs so// gnyis pa khrid tshul gdams ngag dngos rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/ nges shes skyed pa lo rgyus/ smin par byed pa dbang*/ grol bar byed pa khrid/ bsgoms pa las byung ba'i 'bras bu/

zhar byung lag len gyi khyad par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ klong gsal las/ skal ldan nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir// brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bshad par bya// zhes gsungs pas 'di la gsum/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud/ rig 'dzin brda brgyud/ gang zag snyan brgyud do// dang po ni/ gdod ma'i dbyings su chos thams cad kyi chos nyid ka dag (123)gi spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i klong na/ bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po yab yum gnyis lhun grub ye shes kyi skur bzhengs nas rang snang gi 'khor rgyal tshab rigs lnga dang*/ rgyal sras sems dpa' sogs nyid las mi gzhan pa'i tshogs la rdzogs pa chen po sgra tshig bya rtsol las 'das pa dus kun mnyam pa nyid du brjod med kyi sgo nas gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rjes dur khrod me ri 'bar ba'i gnas su sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rje la chos nyid don gyi gnas lugs nyid chos can bya rtsol las 'das pa tshig sdeb sbyor legs pa'i sgo nas bshad/ des dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal du slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la chos nyid bya rtsol las 'das par gsungs/ des so sa gling gi dur khrod du rig 'dzin shrī siṃ ha la mngon sum rang thog tu phab nas gsungs/ des dur khrod chen po bsil sbyin du slob dpon dz+nyā na sū tra la mngon sum yid dpyod bral bas gsungs/ des dur khrod chen po bha sing du paṇa chen bi ma la mi tra la gnas lugs go rtogs dang bral bar ye shes gong 'pho'i tshul du brda dang brda'i sgo nas gsungs pa ni rig 'dzin brda brgyud do// gsum pa ni/ paṇa chen bi ma mi tra nyid kyis mnga' bdag rgyal po dang*/ myang ban ting 'dzin bzang po sogs la gsang ba bla na med pa'i gdams pa rnams mnog chos su gnang zhing*/ myang ban nyid kyis brgyud pa'i bka' srol mi nyams pa'i ched du snyan brgyud rnams 'bro rin chen 'bar dang sbas blo gros dbang phyug gnyis la gtad/

dpe brgyud rnams ma 'ongs pa'i (124)gdul byar dgongs te dbu ru zhwa'i lha khang du sbas pas phyis gnas brtan ldang ma lhun rgyal gyis gter nas bton/ snyan brgyud btsal nas gsan pas bka' gter chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur/ des lce btsun seng ge dbang phyug la gnang*/ rje btsun chen pos kyang zab pa pod bzhi sogs gter nas bzhes shing khyad par byar gyi phu brag dkar them pa 'dra bar paṇa chen bi ma la mi tras gdams ngag rdzogs par zla ba bdun du stsal/ 'o yug phyi gong rdza'i ra bar 'od kyi skur gshegs/ des zhang ston bkra shis rdo rje/ des rje btsun gyi sras mkhas pa nyi ma 'bum/ des chos bdag gu ru jo 'ber/ des 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa/ des grub thob zla ba mun sel/ des rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza/ des mkhas grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan chen po 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po la gdams pa rdzogs par gnang ba yin te/ dam pa 'di ni/ sgra thal 'gyur rtsa ba'i rgyud las lung bstan pa ste/ de'ang kha gcig gis/ de nas blo gros mchog gis 'dzin// ces mtshan gyi rnam grangs tshul khrims blo gros zhes mtshan gyi 'brel dang*/ shes bya la chags thogs med pa'i mkhyen rab kyi rtsal kha rgyas pas don du 'brel gsungs/ dam pa 'ga' zhig gis/ de 'og sgra mkhas dpal 'dzin no// zhes par yang ngos 'dzin cing spyir rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab/ khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos 'khor gzhan dring mi 'jog par bskor ba la kun tu bzang po bshes gnyen gyi rnam par snang ba yin no// yang rgyud de nyid las/ sa la gnas pa'i byang sems kyis// rgya mtsho'i bar (125)du spel bar byed// ces lung bstan pa'i rgyal ba'i dbang po gsum pa rang byung rdo rjes thog mar rig 'dzin ku mā rā dza las gsang ba snying thig gi gdams khrid rdzogs par gsan/

phyis bi ma las dngos su rjes su bzung ba ste/ rdo rje'i gsung las/ bdag ni bi ma la yis byin gyis brlabs// karma'i yang dgon dben par 'dug pa'i tshe// nam langs dus mthar shar gyi phyogs rol nas// lta bas mi ngoms 'od kyis mdzes pa zhig /mngon sum ltar snang bdag gi mdzod spur thim// de nas 'bad med gnas 'di thams cad go /zhes gsungs pa ltar de la brten nas rdzogs pa chen po'i rgyud 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i dgongs pa bde blag tu mkhyen pa'i tshul bstan/ dgongs pa'i klong las brdol ba'i karma snying thig ces mdzad cing*/ mkhas grub kyi zhal slob bzhi la bi ma la dang pad+ma'i snying thig gi chos rnams dbus gtsang khams gsum rgya nag la sogs pa rnams su spel bar bka' bsgos pas lung gi don mngon du gyur/ des na skyes bu chen po 'di gnyis ni rdzogs chen bstan pa'i bdag po sgo thams cad nas 'gran zla dang bral ba yin cing*/ gnyis ka'i bla ma rig 'dzin ku mā rā yin pa dang*/ karma snying thig kyang tshig gi brjod pa phran bu'i khyad par las tshig don gnyis ka'i char bi ma snying thig dang khyad par ci'ang med par ma zad gong ma rnams la bi ma snying thig ma bu dang karma snying thig gi brgyud srol chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur pas nyams len dang 'chad spel gang byas kyang gcig go gcig chod nges par yong ba yin ces kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed sogs kyis yang yang gsungs/ 'on kyang 'dir gtso bor 'chad bya snying thig (126)ma bu'i brgyud srol ni/ kun mkhyen klong chen pa la/ don gnyis mtha' ru phyin pa'i slob ma skyes chen mang du byon pa las/ brgyud pa gtso che ba'i dbang gis mkhas grub khyab brdal lhun grub 'dir 'dren cing*/ des 'jam dbyangs grags pa 'od zer/ des 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas dbon po/ des kun mkhyen zla ba grags pa/ des grub chen kun bzang rdo rje/

des mtshungs med rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ des sprul sku sna tshogs rang grol/ des grub mchog bstan 'dzin grags pa/ des mkhas grub mdo sngags bstan 'dzin/ des rig 'dzin phrin las lhun grub/ des chos kyi rgyal po o rgyan gter bdag gling pa la gnang*/ rje 'di'i phyag bzhes su bi ma la'i man ngag snying thig chen mo zhes yongs su grags pa dang*/ de nyid la chos rje kun mkhyen chen po dri med 'od zer gyis snying thig rtsa ba'i zab gnad gsal byed du mdzad pa'i bla ma yang thig gnyis gdams khrid so sor rang rkang du 'chad pa'ang yod mod/ gtso bor rtsa ba ma bu gnyis gang la brten kyang dmigs pa'i rkang grangs sems sbyong bdun sogs ngo bo mthun pa rnams gcig tu byas shing*/ sgos chos bye brag rnams man ngag gnyis bsdebs nas mdzad pa'i lugs srol 'di gnas skabs su 'jug pa bde zhing*/ don gyi nyams len ma nor tshang phrugs su 'debs pa'i zab gnad gcig grogs gcig 'gro'i gnad kyis gnyis ka'i gdams khrid thob pa'i kun go gcig chod du 'gyur bas mdzad pa'i rgyun ni da lta'i phyag bzhes 'di nyid yin no// gter chen bla mas/ rang sras bi ma'i sprul pa 'gyur med rin chen rnam rgyal dang*/ rje btsun ma mi 'gyur dpal gyi sgron ma sogs la stsal zhing*/ phyi ma (127)ni thal 'gyur las// de nas mkha' 'gro dpal 'dzin mas// bstan pa 'di nyid bzung nas ni// tshe lo bcu ba'i dus su dar// de nas mi gnas rang sa'o// zhes pa'i lung gis bstan pa ltar mkhyen rtogs 'gran zla dang bral zhing bstan pa'i rgyun la bka' drin lhag par che ba dang*/ khyad par snying thig ma bu'i khrid yig bde chen lam bzang sogs snying thig gdams srol gyi mig tu gyur pa'i yig cha'ang mang du mdzad cing*/ lcam dral dam pa de gnyis kyis g.yu sgra'i sprul pa mkhan chen o rgyan bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ des gnubs chen yang sring khri chen phrin las rnam rgyal/

des gter chen rnam 'phrul khri chen pad+ma dbang rgyal/ de las dpal ldan dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal gyis gsan pa las brgyud de dbang lung tshang ma skyes chen dam pa mgon sprul karma gzhan phan mtha' yas las thog mar nos/ yang khri chen phrin las rnam rgyal nas rje btsun rin po che 'gyur med phrin las chos sgron/ de las paṇa chen bi ma la'i rnam 'phrul klong chen gnyis pa kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal gyis gsan/ des kho bo cag la thugs brtse ba chen pos smin grol rgya mtsho lta bu'i bcud du stsal ba ni dbang lung khrid dang nyams rtogs bar ma chad pa'i brgyud tshul shin tu khyad par du 'phags pa yin no// spyir snying thig ya bzhi zhes yongs su grags pa la gnyis bi ma dang*/ gnyis pad+ma snying thig yin la/ de'i ngos 'dzin rnying phyogs phal mo ches bi ma'i snying thig chen mo// de'i bcud 'dril bla ma yang tig gnyis/ las 'brel rtsal gyi gter ma mkha' 'gro snying thig /de'i zab gnad mkha' 'gro yang tig ste bzhir bzhed la (128)yang tig gnyis ni kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi dgongs pa'i gter las 'khrungs pa dang*/ kong po rdzogs chen pa dang rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu sogs ni/ bi ma snying thig ma bu gnyis so sor bgrang*/ mkha' 'gro snying tig ma bu gcig tu bsdams/ de steng rdor sems snying tig bcas gzhir bzhed cing phyi ma la bka' bab rim pa gsum mchis pa 'di ni bai ro'i snying tig gi mtshan gzhi'o// yang kha cig ni rdor sems snying thig mi bgrang bar karma snying thig bcas bzhir byed pa'ang snang la/ rje rang byung bas las 'brel la mkha' 'gro snying tig gsan pa'i gter brgyud kyang da lta bar zam ma chad par bzhugs pa dang*/ kho bo cag gis kyang de dag thams cad skal ba bzang po'i dpyid du nos pas sgo thams cad nas chu bo gcig 'dres su gyur pa ma zad/ karma snying thig sger gyi brgyud pa'ang rang byung zhabs nas nyams khrid bar ma chad pa rim par brgyud/

dpal ldan dpa' bo gtsug lag dga' ba/ kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas/ rje bcu gsum pa bdud 'dul rdo rje/ dpa' bo gtsug lag chos rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal dbang karma pa theg pa mchog gi rdo rjes lung khrid kyi tshul du bka' drin stsal ba'o// 'dir mdo tsam smos pa yin la/ rgyas par na gsang ba snying thig gi bab lugs chen mo'am/ yang tig gi lo rgyus rin po che'i phreng ba/ gter chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i snying thig ma bu'i brgyud pa'i kha skong nges shes 'dren pa'i lcags kyu rnams skabs 'dir 'chad par bya'o// gnyis pa smin par byed pa dbang la gnyis/ gzhi dbang bskur/ srog dam tshig (129)go /dang po ni/ thal 'gyur las/ dbang ni rnam pa bzhi yis kyang*// skal pa ldan par smin par bya// spros bcas nyid dang spros pa med// shin tu spros pa med pa dang*// de bzhin rab tu spros pa med// dbye ba bzhi yi tshul gyis ni// skal ldan rang rgyud smin par byed// ces gsungs te/ de'ang spyir yo ga rnam pa gsum gyi skabs 'dir theg pa 'og ma ltar dka' spyad sogs la ma brten par/ dug lnga lam khyer gyi gdams pas rnam smin kun rtog gi bag chags thabs khyad par can gyis sbyong zhing*/ rang byung gi ye shes mngon sum du ston par byed pa ste/ a bhi ṣiñtsa'i sgra las gtor ba'am blugs pa zhes 'byung bas med snang 'khor ba'i bag chags ma lus pa dag par byed pa'i cha nas gtor ba dang*/ gzhi'i ngo bo gdod nas sku gsum rang chas su bzhugs pa nyid mthong gsal du byed pas blugs pa'ang yin ces gsungs la/ khyad par 'dir ni snang srid ye dag chos nyid byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du rang bzhin spros bral rdzogs pa chen por dbang bskur nas gcer mthong du ngo sprod pa'o// de yang gang zag dbang rab rnams ni dbang dus su grol ba thob pa dang*/ 'bring gis brda' don 'phrod de ye shes phebs pa dang*/

tha mas kyang rgyud la thar pa'i sa bon 'jog pa yin te/ dbang gi las kyis thar pa'i myu gu mngon du bskyed pa'am/ skye nges kyi nus rung du smin pa// zhes gsungs pas so// 'dir man ngag ma bu gnyis bsdebs kyi tshul du gnang yang*/ dbang rnams bla ma yang tig gi nang ltar dang*/ bskur lugs kyang dang po khrid kyi sngon du spros bcas kyi dbang*/ (130)khegs chod kyi sngon du spros med/ thod rgal gyi sngon du shin tu spros med dang*/ rab tu spros med gnyis sbrel mar mdzad pa phyag bzhes yin no// gnyis pa dam tshig ni/ thal 'gyur las/ dbang rten pa yi dam tshig ni// bye brag brjod kyis mi lang yang*// mdor bsdus sku gsung thugs nyid bsrung*// zhes pas bsrung bya'i don las nam yang mi 'da' ba'i sems pa sa bon dang bcas pa ste/ phra rgyas las/ gang zhig nan tan las mi 'gongs// rmi lam du yang dam tshig brjod// dam bca' ba ni sdom par 'dod// ces so// dbye na sku gsung thugs re rer phyi'i phyi/ phyi'i nang*/ phyi'i gsang ba dang*/ de bzhin nang gsang gnyis la'ang sbyar bas rnam grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun/ gzhan yang gsang sngags gi dam rdzas sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga sogs gsang bar 'os pa dang*/ bla ma dang mched rnams kyis spang blang bstan pa rnams gsang bar gnyer gtad pa ste/ mdor na rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig thams cad bag yod dran shes ma bral ba'i sgo nas bsrung dgos te/ dri med rgyal po bshags pa'i rgyud las/ dam tshig sa gzhi lta bu la// thams cad 'bras bu lo tog smin// zhes dang*/ dam tshig mchog gi rgyud las/ 'di las 'gal bar ma byas na// rdo rje 'dzin pa rdzogs sangs rgyas// tshe 'di nyid la thob par nges// zhes sogs gsungs pas/ nyams len dngos gzhi'i 'bras bus rgyud la skye min thams cad 'di las rags las so// gsum pa grol bar byed pa khrid kyi rim pa bstan pa la gsum/

brtson 'grus rab (131)tshe 'dir grol ba/ 'bring bar dor grol ba/ tha ma rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing khams su grol ba bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dmigs gtad gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me zhes bya ba nyams su len pa'i sgom khrigs chen mo las/ dang po rig pa gcer mthong la yid ma ches na: grub mtha' ngan par log pa 'byung dogs srid pas: sngon du byang chub sems sbyong gi man ngag la bslab par bya'o: /de nas sems 'byongs pa'i drod rtags gtan la phebs pa dang : gsang sngags gzhan dag gi man ngag gis lam du drangs te: gang zag chags pa can dang chags pa med pa gnyis su byas nas: rtsa dang rlung dang thig le la bslab par bya'o: de ltar rtsa rlung gi drod rtags gtan la phebs nas: dran pa rgyun gcod kyi man ngag gis rig pa nyid 'byung ba las ldog par bya'o: de ltar 'byung ba lnga las bzlog nas: sbas pa mig 'byed kyi man ngag gis spyod pa sgom pa lta ba 'bras bu'i 'dug tshul blta: zhes dang*/ spyod pa sogs bzhi skor gyi gdams pa'i khrid tshul rgyas par bstan pa dang yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i rtsa ba'i sa bcad zung 'brel lag tu len pa la don gsum du bsdus te/ lam sgom pa'i snod rung du bya ba sngon 'gro'i khrid bstan pa/ dngos gzhi sems rig gtan la 'bebs pa 'od gsal snying po'i don khrid bstan pa/ rjes gnad bzhi chos nyid kyi 'khor los chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya ba'i tshul bstan pa'o// dang po la lnga/ zab lam sgom pa'i mtshams sbyor med du mi rung ba'i thun gyi sngon 'gro bstan pa/ gsang ba snying tig gi khyad chos sems (132)sbyong bdun gyis lam gyi gzhi bca' ba/ thun mong sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor gyis rgyud dag par byed pa/ gsang sngags spyi mthun gyi thabs lam rlung thig gis lus sems sbyong ba/ dran pa rgyun gcod kyi man ngag gis 'byung lnga rang sar dengs par byed pa'o// dang po thun gyi sngon 'gro ni/

gnas dben par bde ba'i stan la lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun drang por bsrang*/ de'ang khrid rim sgom phyin chad spyi dang bye brag gi lus gnad skabs su babs par 'cha' ba las/ lus nyal ba dang bsnyes pa la sogs tha mal du nam yang sdod mi rung ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan lus grong khyer dang 'dra/ rtsa lam srang dang 'dra/ rlung rta dang 'dra/ rnam shes mi zha bo dang 'dra bas byed pa bcings na srang sgo khegs pas mi rta nang du tshud de 'gro mi thub pa dang 'dra ste/ dper na sbrul la yan lag yod kyang ma gcur na mi gsal ba bzhin/ lus ma gcun na sems mi gnas pas rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char ba zhes gong ma rnams kyis zab mo'i gdams ngag gi rkang dang por mdzad do// de nas thun dang por rlung ro dgu phrugs/ 'og ma rnams la sum phrugs su bsal te/ de'ang dang po ni/ sna bug g.yon nas chung 'bring che gsum/ de nas g.yas nas gsum/ gnyis ka chab gcig chung 'bring che gsum bsal ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ g.yon g.yas dbus nas lan re bsal/ de'i tshe/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad kyi tshe rabs thog ma med pa bsags pa'i sdig sgrib gegs dang bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad 'ub kyis 'dus nas (133)sna sgo'i rlung dang 'grogs te phyir sang sang song bas lus kyi nang bshal btang ba ltar dag par gyur snyam du bsam mo// 'dir ni dper na bcud bzang po zhig blugs par byed pa la snga logs su snod bkru bshal byed pa lta bu'o// de nas mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad kyi don du man ngag rdzogs pa chen po'i gdams pa zab mo 'di nyid nyams su blang snyam du sems bskyed dung pa zhig sngon du btang rjes/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor pad+ma'i gdan bzhugs nas// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes brjod pas/

rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam pa can/ mtshan dpe rab tu rdzogs pa'i sku dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ phyag gnyis rdor dril 'dzin cing zhabs sems dpa'i skyil gyis bzhugs pa zhig gsal btab nas ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che mkhyen/ bdag gi rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes pa tsam mam/ de mthar/ zab lam gyi rtogs par khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ tshe 'di nyid la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur tu thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes 'dod pa'i don la zhe thag pa nas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas/ bla ma'i zhabs g.yas pa'i mthe bong las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun babs/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ lus (134)thams cad gang bde ba chen po'i ye shes skyes/ mthar bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la rig pa 'dzin med du 'jog /'di la rig 'dzin tshe dbang nor bu'i gsung rgyun du bla ma gzhi'i kun bzang gi rnam par mdun mkhar thig le sngon po'i dbus su bsgoms nas gsol ba btab rjes hūṃ mthing gar gyur pa 'chad 'gyur rdo rje'i lte bar byon par mos gsungs/ 'di nyid kun mkhyen gyi gzhung khrid du dngos su ma bstan kyang rdo rje lam bstan nas thun mtshams thams cad du bsgom par gsungs pa ltar phyag bzhes su mdzad cing*/ der bla ma dngos sam rdor sems gang rung du bsgom par gsungs pa ltar rang byung zhabs kyis kyang de nyid drangs par mdzad do// gong ltar de'i mthar rang rdo rje sngon po rtse gsum par bsgoms nas rdo rje'i 'dug stangs byas pas bar chad med pa'i rten 'brel dang*/ don dam gyi srung 'khor mchog tu 'gyur ro// gnyis pa gsang ba snying tig gi khyad chos sems sbyong bdun gyis lam gyi gzhi bca' ba ni/

zangs yig can las/ kye ma kye ma/ rigs kyi bu rnams nyon cig /rig pa mngon sum gyi snang ba la blo mi phebs shing dbang po dman pa skal ba zhan pa'i mi rnams kyis 'di la yid mi ches pa 'ga' 'byung srid pas/ de dag rnams rig pa mthong bar bya ba'i ched du 'di rnams la bslab par bya ba yin no// rkyen med pa'i phyogs su phyi nang gi bya ba btang ste/ bsam gtan gyi 'jig pa rnams spangs la dang po sems sbyang bar bya'o// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa ltar 'di la bdun/ mi rtag pa/ 'phral yun gyi bde ba/ rkyen du ma/ (135) /byas pa don med/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan/ bla ma'i man ngag /rnam par mi rtog pa la brten nas sems sbyong ba rnams so// dang po mi rtag pa la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni/ phyi na nam zla dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog /nyin mtshan skad cig thang cig gis kyang mi rtag pa dang*/ nang 'byung bzhi'i phung po 'gyur ldog chu'i lbu ba spungs pa dang 'dra ba myur tu 'jig cing snying po med pas kyang mi rtag pa dang*/ gsang ba pha ma gnyen 'dun shi bas kyang mi rtag pa dang*/ rang la'ang de lta bu'i gnas skabs nam 'byung na ang*/ de ring sang tsam la'ang mi 'chi ba'i gdengs med de/ do nub 'chi'am sang 'chi'am snyam du snying nas skad cig kyang ma yengs par bsam zhing*/ sems can gzhan mthong ba la'ang 'di kun kyang 'chi ba las ma 'das so// nam 'chi'am snyam du bsgom pa'o// des na 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pa'i rang bzhin/ mi rtag pa'i dpe mthong nas blo sna thung du song ba ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do// de ltar bsgoms pas 'khor ba las blo ldog pa'i dgos pa yod do// de nyid gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ phyi rol nyin mtshan dus bzhi'i 'gyur ldog dang*// nang gi phung po gsang ba gnyen 'dun sogs// 'dus byas chos rnams mi rtag myur tu 'jig /snying po med pa chu lbur lta bu'o// zhes 'don bsgom du bya'o// gnyis pa 'phral gyi bde ba dang yun gyi bde ba la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni/

las mi dge bas ngan song dang sdug bsngal gyi rigs thams cad bskyed la/ dge bas mtho ris dang bde ba'i rigs thams cad bskyed cing*/ 'khor ba mtho dman gyi (136)*rang bzhin zo chu'i 'khyud mo 'dra ba/ 'pho zhing rtag mi thub pa 'di mtshangs re che/ 'khor ba mi 'jug pa'i thabs dam pa/ thar pa'i byang chub ma gtogs par yid brtan mi rung zhing bslu ba 'di ya cha/ thar pa'i lam du zhugs na 'phral gyi bde ba mtho ris dang yon tan bzang po rgyud la thob ste rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams bzhin no// yun gyi bde ba bla na med pa'i byang chub 'grub ste sangs rgyas rnams bzhin no// de bas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba phun sum 'tshogs pa bsgrub par bya snyam du bsam mo// des na thar pa'i lam du ma tshud na/ mi dge bas ngan song*/ dge ba byas pas mtho ris su skyes kyang*/ slar ngan song du 'khor ba'i phyir/ byas pa thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rgyur 'dug ang snyams pas snying nas byung ba ni goms pa'i tshad do// des ni 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yid dbyung nas skyo shas drag po rgyud la skye ba'i dgos pa yod do// de gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ dge sdig 'bras bus rigs drug gnas su 'khor// srid pa'i bde 'byor dug can khas zas bzhin// ltar snang bde yang nam phug sdug bsngal rgyu// nges legs thar pa'i lam mchog kho na'o// gsum pa rkyen du ma la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni/ 'khor ba skyes dus na yid brtan dang blo gtad mi 'dug ste/ phan btags kyang lan du gnod pa bskyal ba dang*/ zas skom zos kyang nad dang 'chi rkyen du 'gro ba dang*/ yo byad bsags kyang dgra rkun gyi 'dod pa sgrub pa dang*/ phan du re nas gnyen bshes su btags pas gnod pa'i dgrar 'gyur ba dang*/ gnod pa ma byas kyang don med pa'i ngan smras dang skur bar 'gyur ba dang*/ (137)gang byas kyang gzhan gyi yid mi mgu ba dang*/

zin pa'i dus med pa 'di mtshangs re che/ sems can gyi bsam spyod la snying nas bsam na gang ltar phan btags kyang la la mgu dus la la mi mgu/ ji ltar bsams kyang mtha' gcig tu phan med// ci byas thams cad sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ nang rkyen dang 'chi rkyen grangs mang ba 'di dag la dngos su phan pa mi 'grub pas/ blo ltos mi bslu bar bla ma dkon mchog las gzhan med pa'i phyir mos gus dang mchod pa byas na 'di phyir bde ba'i rgyu yin pas/ blo sna de dge ba 'ba' zhig la bsgyur dgos snyam du rkyen bzang ngan sngar byung ba dang*/ da lta byed pa dang*/ phyis byed 'gyur rnams la bsam zhing*/ skyo shas dang blo sna bstung bar bya'o// des na rigs drug gi sems can rnams la snying rje skye zhing*/ las su dkon mchog dang*/ bla ma mchod na ci ma rung snyam pa ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do// des ni dad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod do// de gsal gdab pa ni/ rkyen snang 'khrul pa'i bya ba zin dus med// ji ltar byas kyang 'dod thog bab mi 'gyur// smig rgyu'i chu la ri dwags snyegs pa bzhin// de bas blo sna dge la bsgyur bar bya// bzhi pa byas pa thams cad don med par sems sbyong ba ni/ bdag gis tshe 'di'i bya bzhag /gnyen skyong ba// dgra 'dul ba/ so nam zhib tig /tshong khe spogs/ khe grags lo 'dod/ chags sdang*/ zhe sdang*/ gzhan gyis sha tsha gros 'debs/ che thabs dang*/ gtam snyan 'dod pa la sogs pa nas/ gnyen grogs dang lhan cig longs spyod dang bshes (138)'dris/ gnas khyim mkhar las la sogs pa ci dang ci byas kyang shi ba'i nangs par 'grogs nas mi 'gro bas phan med de/ khar sang phan chad kyi bya byed ci dang ci byas dran pa'i yul tsam las phyir mi 'ong bas mdang gi rmi lam dang 'dra/ de ring gi snang ba do nub kyi rmi lam dang 'dra/ sang phan chad byed pa rnams sang dgong gi rmi lam dang 'dra ba zhig yin par 'dug pa la/

don med pa'i chags sdang dang*/ 'thab rtsod/ snyan mi snyan/ bde sdug gsog 'jog bya byed rnam pa sna tshogs pa zhig gis dus 'das pa 'di mtshangs re che// 'jig rten gyi snang ba sgyu ma'i bslu brid du 'dug pa/ de ring las ma gtogs pa lings kyis blos btang la/ bla ma dam pa'i gdams ngag cig rgyud la nyams su blang dgos snyam du bsam mo// des na snang ba gang la'ang blo gtad med pas bla ma'i gdams ngag cig thob par bya dgos snyam pa dung gis byung ba ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do// des ni bla ma'i gdams ngag la 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod do// de gsal gdab pa ni/ 'jig rten bya bzhag don med chags sdang gzhi// gnyid thun gcig gi rmi lam bzang ngan ltar// snang ba sgyu mas bslus pa mtshangs re che// lings kyis bor te zab mo'i gdams ngag bsgom// lnga pa sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la brten nas sems sbyong ba ni/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa thams cad las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas te/ sku mtshan dang dpe byad du 'bar ba/ gsung chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ thugs ye shes kyi ngang las mi g.yo ba/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dren pa dam pa gtso bo gcig su skyabs snang dpung gnyen du gyur pa yin pas thob par bya dgos/ sangs ma rgyas na phan mi 'dug sangs rgyas thob par byed pa (139)la'ang lam ma bsgoms na mi thob pas/ cis kyang bsgom dgos/ grub thob gong ma ngo mtshar can rnams kyi rjes bsnyags la sgrub pa rtse gcig tu bya dgos/ khong rnam pas dka' ba du ma spyad/ gcig pur dben par bsgoms pas grol ba ltar bdag gis kyang tshe 'di'i bya ba blos btang la gcig pur dben pa'i gnas su bsgrub dgos snyam du bsam mo// des na ma bsgoms na sangs mi rgya bas/ cis kyang bsgom dgos snyam pa rgyud la skyes pa ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do// des ni bsgom pa la bsran tshugs pa'i dgos pa yod do// de gsal gdab pa ni/

sangs rgyas sku gsum yon tan tshad med ldan// rang la yod pa de nyid bsgoms na thob// skyes bu 'brum nad 'byongs bzhin mi ldog pas// gtan bde'i go 'phang dka' ba spyad la bsgrub// drug pa/ bla ma'i gdams ngag la bsam ste sems sbyong ba ni/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gting mtha' med pa las sgrol ba'i ded dpon ni bla ma yin la/ sgrol ba'i thabs kyi gru bo che ni bla ma'i gdams ngag yin pas/ ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du nyams su blang dgos te/ ma blang na sdug bsngal gyi nad kyis gtan du gdung ba'i phyir na bla ma sman pa'i rgyal po ni brtse ba chen po ste/ gdams ngag sman gyi bdud rtsis nyin mtshan bsran tshugs par byas la/ nyams su blang dgos snyam nas rgyu mtshan du ma la bsam te bsgom pas/ tshe 'di'i bya bas ci bya/ bla ma'i gdams ngag kho na nyams su blang dgos snyam pa ni 'byongs pa'i tshad do// des ni bya ba gzhan la blo mi 'jug par gdams ngag la rtse gcig tu 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod do// de gsal gdab pa ni/ (140)bla ma sman pa gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sgrol ba'i gru bo che// thar pa'i khang bzang bgrod pa'i them skas mchog /nyin mtshan bsran btsugs de don nyams su blang*// bdun pa rnam par mi rtog pa la brten nas sems sbyong ba ni/ de yang*/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// ces gsungs pas sngon chad ma rig pa'i rnam par rtog pas khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas su yang nas yang du 'khor zhing 'khyams pas sdug bsngal bar gyur la/ da ni bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa zhig bya snyam pa'i sgo nas sbyong ba ste/ de la'ang gsum/ bde stong*/ gsal stong*/ chos nyid rnam par mi rtog pa la brten nas sbyong ba'o// dang po ni lus gnad chos bdun bcas la rang lus stong chen sgrib thogs dang bral ba'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug 'bring po tsam phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/

dwangs gsal sbugs stong gi yar sna tshangs bug dang*/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du drang tha ler gnas par bsam/ de ltar gsal ba'i yar snar thabs kyi rang bzhin haṃ yig dkar po mgo bo thur lta bde ba'i rang bzhin 'dzag la khad pa/ mar sna shes rab kyi rang bzhin a yig dmar po mgo bo gyen bstan 'bar la khad pa zhig gsal btab/ de ltar gsal bar gyur pa dang rlung ro gsum phrugs su bsal/ de nas steng rlung nar gyis rngubs rjes 'og rlung bskums pas a las gtum mo'i me chos bzhi ldan gyen du 'bar ba dbu ma'i khong seng du dmar khyug gi song*/ spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas byang sems bde ba'i rgyun skya shar gyis babs pas sdong rtsa mar khus brlan pa ltar lte ba'i a yig las me chen 'bar/ (141)zla ba bdud rtsir zhu ba'i dwangs mas dbu ma dang*/ lus nang 'khor lo bzhi sogs gang bas bde drod kyi ye shes skyes par bsam zhing*/ a haṃ la shes pa mi gtod par snying gar a yig dkar po gsal zhing 'tsher ba zhig la sems bzung ste bum can kha sbyor du 'ching*/ mi thub na rngub chung byas la gzhil ba bya/ de nas phra la ring ba'i shugs kyis phyir 'phang ngo*// de ltar bum can che 'bring chung gsum gang rung ma grub kyi bar du 'bad cing*/ ma goms par rlung ha cang gi drags pa ma yin par 'jam zhing ran par bzung bar bya/ de ltar goms pas bde bas thabs byas pa'i shes rab stong nyid kyi ye shes skye bar 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ sna bug gnyis nas rlung phra la ring ba phyir sang gis bsal la/ tshogs drug gi yul snang thams cad nam mkha'i rang bzhin du sngo mer gyis zhu bar bsams pa la sems gtad de rlung phyir mnan/ de nas rlung nar gyis rngub pas snang yul nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de nyid sna bug nas zhugs// lte bar sngo mer gyis gnas par bsams la bum can kha sbyor du 'ching*/ de yang lus tsha ba shas che na rlung bsil ba'i rang bzhin dang*/

grang ba shas che na reg bya tsha ba'i rang bzhin can du bsgom/ de lta bu'i bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan la 'bad rtsol chen pos bsgoms pas rlung yun ring bkag kyang ngal ba ma byung na goms pa'i rtags su gsungs shing*/ des ni gsal bas thabs byas pa'i stong nyid rnam par mi rtog pa rgyud la skye'o// gsum pa ni/ lus gnad sngar ltar las/ ngag gnad rlung rang babs la bzhag /sems gnad dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi (142)mno mi sems bcas bcos mi bya bar rang babs bzo med du 'bol le yengs med du hrig ger 'jog go /de ltar bzhag pas sems gar gtad la zin cing*/ rtog med rang gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du gnas pa na goms pa'i tshad do// des ni byang chub kyi sems gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa khyad par can yod do// de gsal gdab pa ni/ bde gsal rnam par mi rtog mkha' lta bu// bsam gtan dam pa'i bde bas rgyud dul ba// zhing sa gshin por lo tog legs pa bzhin// ting 'dzin kun gyi gzhi rten bsgrub par bya// zhes 'don bsgom du bya'o// 'dir rig 'dzin chen po'i khrid rgyun tu/ mi rtag pa la sems sbyangs mtshams skyabs 'gro/ sems sbyong gnyis pa'i rjes su sems bskyed/ gsum pa bzhi pa gnyis kyi rjes su maṇ+ḍal/ lnga pa'i rjes su rdor sems sgom bzlas/ drug pa'i rjes su bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ de nas sems sbyong bdun pa'i rjes su rlung thig bslab pa la 'jug par mdzad do// gsum pa thun mong sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor gyis rgyud dag par byed pa ni/ zangs yig can dang kun mkhyen chen po'i don khrid du gsal kha ma gsungs kyang*/ yi ge dmar ru'i rgyab yig las/ dben pa'i gnas su bsod nams kyi tshogs sngon du 'gro bas/ zhes gzhung gi shugs bstan tsam gyis gsungs shing*/ gter chen yab sras sogs brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis phyag bzhes par ma chad pa ste/

de la lnga/ lam dman pa las khyad par du gyur pa skyabs 'gro'i khrid/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i snying po rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi khrid/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs par (143)byed pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid/ byin rlabs myur tu 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid do// dang po skyabs 'gro la gnyis kun rdzob dang don dam mo// dang po ni/ de yang rang cag rnams mi dge bcu spong gi tshul khrims sogs dge ba'i las kyis re zhig bde 'gro'i gnas su skyes kyang sdug bsngal spangs pa'i thar ba bla na med pa'i byang chub ma thob na sngar gyi dge ba'i 'phen pa zad nas slar yang ngan song du lhung ste/ yun ring la dos drag pa'i sdug bsngal mi bzod pa sna tshogs myong dgos pa 'dug /de las skyob nus pa ni dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum ma gtogs gzhan su yang med/ de yang rang la dngos su snang ba'i sangs rgyas ni bla ma dam pa ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med pa'i phyir/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la skyabs dang ram zla zhu snyam du lus sems rnal du phab/ rang gar gnas kyi sa phyogs de nyid rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus su dpag bsam gyi sdong po yal ga lo 'dab rab tu rgyas pas nam mkha'i khams kun yongs su khyab pa'i dbus kyi yal ga'i snying por seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan mtho zhing yangs pa'i steng du/ ngo bo drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid rnam pa dpal kun tu bzang po longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can/ sku mdog mthing ga gsal zhing 'tsher ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan phun sum tshogs pas mdzes par spras pa/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab tu rdzogs pa'i sku can du gsal ba'i mtha' bskor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/

phyogs bzhir gyes pa'i yal ga rnams la gdan gyi bkod pa mtho zhing yangs pa re re gsal bar gyur pa'i mdun la khyad par gyi sangs rgyas dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la yi dam rgyud sde (144)drug gi lha tshogs kyis bskor ba/ g.yas kyi gdan la thun mong gi sangs rgyas ston pa thub pa'i dbang po la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul sku rnams kyis bskor ba/ rgyab kyi gdan la lung rtogs kyi dam chos dkon mchog rnams glegs bam brtsegs pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ g.yon gyi gdan la spyan ras gzigs dang 'jam dpal phyag rdor sogs byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang*/ 'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang mau dgal gyi bu sogs nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams bzhugs pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su khyad par gyi dge 'dun mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de'i mdun du rang dang sems can thams cad sa chen po'i dregs pa bzhin 'khod cing*/ thams cad kyang lus ngag yid gsum gus pa chen po dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro lhan cig tu byed par mos la/ bdag dang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las da lta nyid du drang zhing bskyab tu gsol snyam pa'i yid gzhan du ma yengs pas/ nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// bdag sogs 'gro drug gus pas skyabs su mchi// zhes brgya stong sogs ci nus su 'don cing*/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ skyabs yul rnams kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros rang dang sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs dag pa'i zhing du 'ur gyi song*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dkon mchog gsum sogs 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku la bsdus/

rtsa (145)ba'i bla ma yang 'od du zhu ba rang gi spyi bo nas snying gar sib kyi thim par bsam la skyabs su 'gro bya 'gro byed mi dmigs pa'i ngang du ci nus mnyam par bzhag /nub mo nyal ba'i tshe tshogs zhing ma bsdus par de la sngas phyogs pas mos gus dung nge ba'i ngang la gnyid du 'gro bar bya zhing*/ thun mtshams rnams su'ang tshogs zhing gsal btab la phyag mchod sogs la 'bad pa gal che'o// 'dir rig 'dzin chen po'i khrid rgyun tu/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sku dngos kyi rnam pa phyogs mtshams rnams su skyabs yul rnams sprin phung 'khrigs pa'am/ me tog gi tshom bu bkram pa'am nam mkha'i skar ma bzhin du go mtshams med par khyab pa'i tshul du sgom zhing skyabs yul mchog dman la ltos pa'i steng 'og mtho dman dang mtha' dbus kyi rnam pa tsam ma gtogs lnga tshom lta bu'i ka dpe ma mi dgos gsungs/ mthar skyabs yul gshegs bsdu'i spros pa med pa dmigs med du 'jog pa'i lugs so// skyabs 'gro'i go don rnam gzhag phan yon sogs spro na spyi ltar 'chad par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ rang gi lus kyi 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa 'dab dge 'dun/ thig le chos/ rlung lnga'i dwangs ma ye shes lnga ni/ nyon mongs pa ye nas dag pa'i sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid du rang ngo shes nas bsgom snyam du/ rlung lnga rnam dag dwangs ma'i sku// nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes lnga// sku gsum mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// dkon mchog gsum la rtogs pas 'dud// ces lan ci rigs brjod la 'od gsal gyi rang ngor mnyam par gzhag go /gnyis pa sems bskyed pa la'ang gnyis kun rdzob dang*/ don dam mo// (146)dang po ni/ don dam par gzod ma nas rnam par dag kyang*/ kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rtag par longs spyod pa'i ma rgan sems can thams cad gdod ma'i mgon po'i go 'phang la 'god pa dang*/

rang gi rig pa mngon sum gyi ye shes lam snang ba rnam pa bzhi nyams su blang snyam pa'i sems snga na med pa bskyed la/ e ma ho// ma rig 'jig rten mun pa'i klong*// rang gi thabs shes sgron me yis// rang la gnas pa'i ye shes de// bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs par bya'o// zhes lan grangs ci nus brjod la smon pa sems bskyed/ dbyings ka dag chos sku skye med nam mkha' lta bu dang*/ ye shes lhun grub rang rig sku gsum gyi ngo bo spros pa'i mtha' bzhi las 'das pa tshig dang yi ge med pa'i don/ smra bsam brjod med chen po nyid rang ngo shes par bya snyam du/ e ma ho/ sangs rgyas mthar thug dbyings rig gnyis// sku gsum ngo bo mtha' bral gzhi// tshig las 'das pa'i rang byung de// da lta nyid du rtogs par bya'o// zhes lan grangs ci nus su brjod la 'jug pa sems bskyed do// gnyis pa ni/ don dam par chos thams cad gzod ma nas spang blang bcings grol med pa mnyam rdzogs chen po'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas pas 'khor ba dang myang 'das/ sangs rgyas dang sems can/ bdag gzhan bzang ngan tha dad du grub pa med pa yin pa la yin par shes pas rgyu 'bras rtsol sgrub las 'das pa ye grol chos sku'i dgongs pa rang chas lhun 'byams chen po'i ngang du la bzla bar bya'o snyam pas/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams// ye nas sangs rgyas (147)yin pa la// yin par shes pa'i bdag nyid du// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// zhes brjod/ gzhan yang spro na kun rdzob byang sems kyi nyams len gtso bor dbugs 'byung 'jug dang sbyar ba'i bde sdug gtong len gyi dmigs pa dang*/ 'khor gsum rang bzhin med pa don dam sems bskyed kyi rang ngo la mnyam par gzhag go /'dir sems bskyed kyi ngo bo// mtshan nyid/ bskyed tshul/ bslab bya sogs 'chad par spro na spyi ltar bshad do// gsum pa sdig sgrib sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas kyi khrid la gnyis/

spyi dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i steng du a yig dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dngul dkar gyi dril bu dkur brten pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs shing yum snyems ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūṃ yig dkar po/ de'i mtha' bskor du yi ge brgya ba'i sngags phreng dkar po 'od zer phrom phrom g.yo ba g.yas su 'khor ba gsal gdab/ de ltar spyi bo'i bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' skyabs gnas kun 'dus su mos pa rten gyi stobs/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa mi dge ba'i las thams cad la gnang 'gyod drag pos dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' khyed mkhyen no// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis sngon chad sdig pa'i las bgyis pa thams cad mthol zhing (148)bshags so// byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol snyam pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ da phyin chad 'chi ba srog la babs kyang sdig pa'i las dngos su lta ci/ rmi lam du'ang mi bgyid snyam pa nyes pa las sor chud pa'i stobs/ sngar byas kyi gnyen por rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la spyod pa gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs te/ de ltar stobs bzhi dran bzhin pas yig brgya gsol 'debs kyi tshul du brgya stong sogs ci nus bzlas pas/ sngags phreng rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun skya chil gyi babs pas yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas thon rang gi tshangs bug tu zhugs/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu dang rnag khrag ljan ljin dang srog chags phra mo la sogs pa'i rnam par ba spu'i khung bu dang*/

gshang lam dang chu lam sogs nas phu chu drag pos thal ba ded pa ltar thon par bsam la de nyid gsal gdab pa'i phyir/ rang lus tha mal spyi gtsug tu: pad dkar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng : a las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar: rdor dril 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud: rin chen rgyan spras sems skyil bzhugs: thugs kar zla steng hūṃ gi mthar: snying po yi ge brgya pas bskor: sku dang sngags las bdud rtsi'i rgyun: dkar nar babs te spyi bor zhugs: bdag gi lus kun gang ba yis: sdig sgrib dag nas shel gong ltar: dri ma med pa'i lus su gyur: ces ngag tu brjod cing dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gcun la yig brgya bzla/ mthar lus shel gong dri ma med pa ltar gyur pa'i nang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mer khrig gis gang bar gyur pas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi dngos grub thob par bsam zhing*/ mthar mos gus gdung shugs drag pos/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis:(149)dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams: bla ma mgon pos bskyab mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste: thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can: 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad mthol zhing bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib thams cad nas dus da lta nas dag go zhes gnang ba stsal te 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang sems dang dbyer med bshags bya bshags byed mi dmigs pa'i ngang la yun ji srid gnas kyi bar mnyam par bzhag /tshul de lta bu'i sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags ma mthong gi bar du 'bad par bya zhing*/ spro na nyes ltung dang gnyen po'i rnam bzhag /bsgom bzlas kyi phan yon spyi ltar 'chad do// gnyis pa ni/

skad cig gis pad zla'i dbus su rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i snying nang zla ba'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po tshon gang ba lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i mtha' bskor du yi ge brgya pa dkar ser mar me lta bu'i 'od kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs te/ snang ba thams cad rdo rje sems dpa'i sku/ sgra skad thams cad yi ge brgya par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra s+t+wa sa ma ya// ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra s+t+wa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su toṣ+yo me bha wa/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+tau me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ (150)sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru+u hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya s+t+wa āḥ zhes ci 'grub bzlas pa'i rjes la snang ba thams cad thugs ka'i hūṃ la bsdu/ hūṃ mi dmigs pa'i ngang la bzhag ste/ bsngo ba byas pas bskal pa 'bum phrag du mar bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag cing nyams chags thams cad bskangs nas sems nyid kyi don rtogs pa'i dgos pa yod do// 'di ni yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i rtsa ba'i chos sde snyan brgyud ye shes rang snang las sgrib pa sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor gyis blo sbyong zhes dngos su bstan pa lugs 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa nyid do// 'dir rig 'dzin chen po'i khrid rgyun tu/ phyi bya rgyud ltar bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' spyi bor bsgom pa/ nang spyod rgyud ltar snying gar bsgom pa/ gsang ba rnal 'byor rgyud ltar sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgom pa/ yang gsang bla med ltar khyer so gsum ldan du bsgom pa/ de kho na nyid chos kyi dbyings su la bzla ba dang lnga las/

dang po ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad de las 'dab ma gcig la gcig mthud kyi tshul du nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa'i bar du khyab pa/ de lta bu'i 'dab ma re re'i 'og tu sems can re re 'khod pa/ de re re'i spyi gtsug gi pad 'dab steng du yang rdo rje sems dpa' re bzhugs pa/ de thams cad kyang rdor sems spyi mthun yab rkyang sems skyil can/ thugs kar sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas sras bcas bstim/ bzlas pa dang bdud rtsi 'bebs sbyong mthar/ mgon po bdag ni sogs/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che sogs sh+tso kas bstod/ (151)rdo rje sems dpas dbugs dbyung ste/ gnyis pa dang sbrel na rang gi spyi bor bzhugs pa'i mu nas sku'i byin rlabs bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyi rnam par slar yang babs mgrin pa yan chad gang lus kyi sdig sgrib dag sku'i byin rlabs thob par bsam/ yang rdor sems mgrin par byon gsung gi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam pa babs snying ga yan gang ngag gi sgrib pa dag /yang snying gar byon thugs kyi byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i rnam par babs lte ba yan chad gang 'di la yun ring du 'bad/ thugs kyi byin rlabs thob par mos// de dag gi skabs su yig brgya bzla/ de nas gsum pa dang sbrel na/ bdud rtsis lus thams cad gang sgrib pa mtha' dag dag /rnam smin gyi phung po gnas 'gyur nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐/ der dmigs nas yig brgya bzla/ bzhi pa dang sbrel na/ de'i mthar snang grags rig gsum rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gsung thugs su mos te/ yig drug bzla// lnga pa ni/ dmigs bral ka dag gi ngang du mnyam par gzhag par gsungs so// bzhi pa tshogs gnyis rdzogs byed maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid ni/

tshogs zhing skyabs yul ltar gsal gdab par bshad pa ni dmigs pa'i rnam grangs mang po mi 'chun pa dang spyi mthun gyi phyag len stabs bde ba la dgongs pa des kyang 'thus mod/ 'dir rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa ni phyi nas rim bzhin 'chad par bya'o// maṇ+ḍal gyi rgyu rab rin po che gser dngul/ 'bring za ras sogs/ (152)tha ma rdo shing lta bu dngos po dman na khru gang ba las mi chung ba dang*/ tshom bu'i rgyu'ang rab rin po che/ 'bring dung dang mgron bu sogs/ tha ma 'bru gtsang ma dri bzang gis kha bsgyur ba la sman khrol bu sogs gang 'dzom bsres shing gsher gyis brlan pa dang dri bzang ba byung yang 'du bya/ rang dang sems can thams cad lhan cig pas lus kyi las su tshom bu 'god pa/ ngag gi las su 'bul tshig rnams 'ur dir gyis 'don pa/ yid kyi tshig phyir sems ma yengs par bya ba rnams sum phrugs su bya zhing*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga dngos la gsum// dang po sprul sku'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ tshogs zhing mdun du rdo rje'i zhing khams chen po rnam par dag pa'i rin po che'i rang bzhin ri rab gling bzhi dang bcas pa'i ri rtser pad zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma sprul pa'i sku'i rnam pa can la dgongs brda snyan brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ gling dang gling bar rnams su khyad par gyi dkon mchog skyabs yul gyi skabs ltar bzhugs par mos la/ thog mar sems kyi rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i brdar maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phyis/ byang chub sems kyi rlan mi yal ba'i phyir dri bzang dang ba byung chus chags chags gdab/ tshom bu rab bzhi bcu rtsa gcig /'bring nyi shu rtsa gsum/ bsdus pa la dgu dgod par gsungs pa las 'bring po'i lugs byed na ri rab gling bzhi gling phran bcas bcu gsum/ phyogs mtshams brgyad du brgyad bkod pa bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs mchod rdzas phyogs bsdus/ mdun rgyab gnyis su gnyis bkod pa nyi zla mtshon pa yin la/

de dag kyang 'jig rten khams rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i phyi nang snod bcud kyi dpal 'byor rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho'i zhing (153)khams kyi bkod pa la brten pa'i tshangs chen gyi bskal pa chen po nam mkhas khyab tshad du sprul nas dus chad pa med par 'bul bar bsam la ngag 'don dang dmigs pa sbrags te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro// sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ gter gyi bum pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod yon/ shin tu mdzes pa'i lha mo// nyi ma/ zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi yi 'dod yon ma tshang ba med pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho legs par bkod de bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho'i sku dang gsung dang thugs mi bzad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams mtha' klas pa tshangs chen gyi bskal pa chen pos legs par brgyan pa 'di nyid bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs te 'bul lo// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed ri rab gling bzhi'i 'jig rten khams/ lha dang mi yi 'dod yon phun tshogs bde gshegs mchod pa'i sprin phung can// tshangs chen bskal pas legs par brgyan te dge legs rgya mtsho'i bsod (154)nams zhing*// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// rin chen maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin// rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'di phul bas// rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing la spyod par shog

/ces tshom bu gso zhing shwa lo ka phyi ma la grangs bzung ste ci nus su 'bul lo// gnyis pa longs sku'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ tshogs zhing 'og min stugs po bkod pa'i zhing khams gzhi dang rgya tshad rgyan bkod pa'i khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab par bla ma longs sku rigs lnga 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa bzhugs par mos la/ tshom bu rgyas pa nyer lnga/ 'bring la bcu gsum/ bsdu na bdun bkod de/ stugs po bkod pa'i zhing khams thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang bsam las 'das pa'i bkod pa yid du 'ong ba'i lha mo ngo mtshar ba'i mchod rdzas thogs pas gang ba tshangs pa rnga sgra'i zhing khams chen po ye shes rin po che'i sprin gyi drwa bas legs par brgyan pas 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor mchod par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'og min gyi gnas rnam dag stugs po bkod pa bde ba'i zhing*/ thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa'i zhing khams na/ shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i gzhal med khang chen po/ sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa la/ rin po che'i gdugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu mdzes pa'i ri dwags/ lha'i gos rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'phan/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ gser gyi dril bu g.yar kha'i phreng ba/ rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog (155)rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na/ rin po che'i pha gu/ nor bu sna tshogs kyi drwa phyed/ rdo kra ma shīṇa'i mda' yab/ rin po che'i drwa mig /gseng ma'i pu shu/ rab tu mtho ba'i phyur bu/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ zhal zas ma/ sil snyan ma/ mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyi nang kun tu yang legs par brgyan te bkod pa'i gnas/ tshangs pa rnga sgra'i zhing khams chen po/

ye shes rin po che sprin gyi drwa bas legs par brgyan pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor 'bul lo// bde chen gnas ni shin tu mtha' yas bkod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer can/ sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan ye shes rnam lnga'i rtsigs pas brgyan// sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od 'phro ba// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// 'og min bde chen rin chen gzhal yas khang*/ sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi bla bre can// nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te phul ba yis// lhun grub longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog ces shwa lo ka phyi ma la grangs bzung zhing 'bul lo// gsum pa chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ tshogs zhing chos sku thig le nyag cig 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams su bla ma chos sku gdod ma'i mgon po 'khor rang snang ye shes rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas rang gsal lhun grub tu (156)bzhugs par mos la/ tshom bu rgyas par nyer lnga/ 'bring la lnga/ bsdu na gsum bkod de/ chos dbyings 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams tshad dpag tu med cing nam mkha'i mtha' klas par rig gdangs 'od lnga'i thig le thig phran 'ja' 'od zer thag mer mer shig shig tu g.yo ba'i sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba tshad med pas brgyan pa nyid mchod bya mchod byed med par rang byung rang shar rang thim du 'bul bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos nyid 'od gsal gyi zhing khams gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag cing*/ nam mkha' ltar stong la mtha' dbus med pa/ nyi zla ltar bkra zhing lhun gyis grub pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gang yang ma phyed mi 'byed pa med pa'i rang bzhin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang 'gro ba drug gi rnam par 'phrul pa/

dpag tu med pa'i 'byung gnas chen po/ lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs/ sku gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i klong*/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gzhon nu bum pa sku'i zhing khams phyi dang nang med pa kun tu yang nang du gyur pa/ sngon po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po dang*/ ljang khu'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba chen pos legs par brgyan pa'i bkod pa tshad med pa'i mnga' thang chen po la dbang 'byor ba/ 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams/ rang bzhin rnam par dag cing lhun gyis grub pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ dgongs klong rnam par dag pa'i ngang du ye shes kyi mchod pa dam par 'bul lo// gdod (157)nas rnam dag 'od gsal zhing ni ma skyes lhun rdzogs 'dus ma byas/ sna tshogs ma dmigs spros kun nyer zhi ye shes rnam lnga'i gzhal yas khang*// sku gsum mdzad pa'i 'od zer dang bcas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// 'od gsal lhun grub ye shes rigs lnga'i zhing*// sku dang thig les ye nas brgyan pa 'di// rang snang dag pas legs par phul ba yis// kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /ces sho lo ka phyi ma la grangs bzung ste ci nus 'bul/ mthar maṇ+ḍal 'bul yul mchod rdzas dang bcas pa hūṃ sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ de yang rang la thim par bsam zhing tshogs chen lhun gyis rdzogs pa'i 'od gsal gyi ngang du mnyam par gzhag go /'dir yang spyi dang bye brag gi rnam gzhag dgos pa phan yon sogs 'chad par spro na gzhan nas blang ngo*// lnga pa byin rlabs myur tu 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la'ang gnyis/ spyi dang*/ khyad par ro// dang po la/

gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten gsal 'debs pa ni/ snod bcud dag pa'i zhing khams 'byams klas pa'i dbus su/ rang gi spyi bo'i nam mkhar ye shes lnga'i rang mdangs 'ja' tshon 'od lnga'i gur khyim rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus su seng khri pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i ston pa kun tu bzang po sku mdog mthing ga in+d+ra ni la'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i gzi byin rab tu 'bar zhing phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi rgya can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing dar gyi chas gos lnga dang rin po che'i rgyan brgyad kyis mdzes par brgyan pa/ sku la (158)mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa/ shin tu dwangs pa'i sku las dri ma med pa'i 'od zer kha dog drug gi snang ba re re yang bye ba phrag drug drug tu 'phro zhing 'bar ba'i klong na lham mer bzhugs pa/ gsung yan lag drug cu'i chos sgra sgrog pa/ thugs ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo brgya phrag du ma la mnyam par gzhag pa/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can du gsal ba'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ mtha' skor du theg pa che chung gi yi dam sangs rgyas/ dam chos dge 'dun/ mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad sprin gyi phung po gtibs pa lta bur bzhugs par bsam la de nyid gsal gdab pa'i slad du/ snod bcud dag pa'i zhing khams chen po'i dbus// rang mdun nam mkhar ye shes 'od lnga'i klong*// seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// dbyer med gdod ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang*// mthing gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag can// dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// mtha' bskor mchog gsum mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs// snang stong zung 'jug ye shes sgyu ma'i sku// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i sprin// gang 'dul mos dor cir yang 'char bar gyur// ces brjod/

de nas rang dang sems can thams cad sa chen po'i rdul ltar 'khod par gyur pa la/ thams cad lus gus pas thal mo sbyar/ ngag gus pas gsol 'debs kyi tshig dir dir brjod/ yid gus pas skyid sdug legs nyes thams cad khyed kyis mkhyen snyam pa'i blo gtad ling gis 'gel/ de (159)yang bla ma ni sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin du bzhugs par ma zad/ rang la sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhal mjal zhing gsung thos pa'i skal ba ma mchis pa'i dus 'dir de rnams kyis mdzad rgyu bla ma dam pas mdzad pa dang*/ rang rgyud la sangs rgyas dngos su ston pa'i ded dpon bla na med pa yin pa'i phyir dus gsum gyi rgyal ba kun las lhag cing bka' drin che snyam pa'i blo sna mos gus su hril gyis dril la brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin sprin tshogs dang*/ bsdu na gter chen rin po ches mdzad pa rje bla ma'i kha skong dang bcas pa nyid brjod la/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi yon tan rjes su dran bzhin pas gsol ba gdab cing*/ slar yang rtsa ba'i bla ma la phur tshugs su gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ kye bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig pu// 'gro ba skyabs med rnams kyi skyabs// thar pa'i them skas chen po ste// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la// mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// nyon mongs me yis gdungs pa la// thugs rje'i char gyis bsil bar mdzod// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che// bdag la re sa gzhan na med// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// skyid sdug re ltos khyed mkhyen pas// mgon med bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// nad gdon bgegs dang bar chad sol// sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// ces pas (160)mos gus kyi nyams ma skyes bar du gsol ba btab pa'i mthar dbang blang ba ni/

'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku la thim pas bla ma sngar bas kyang gzi byin cher 'bar ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od 'bar bas mtshan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur/ bdag dang mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad dbang bzhi'i chu bos rgyud smin cing grol bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gu ru'i spyi bo'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ rang gi spyi bor thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ dag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rtsa rlung bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rang gi snying gar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas/ slar yang gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rdzogs pa chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i skal ba can du byas so// slar yang dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo sku bzhi'i bdag (161)nyid dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zab lam gyi rtogs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ka dag gnas lugs kyi lta ba rtogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lhun grub snang bzhi'i ye shes mthar phyin par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas bla ma 'od lnga'i gong bur gyur pa rang gi tshangs bug nas sib kyis thim pas/

rang gi sgo gsum dang bla ma'i rdo rje gsum dbyer med gyur par bsam la blo 'das gnyug ma'i rang ngo la mnyam par gzhag go /gnyis pa bye brag bla ma'i rim pa dngos grub rgya mtsho ltar nyams su len pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa skyob mdzad pa// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// nges pa'i don du sems bskyed nas// 'gro la phan phyir bla ma bsgom// chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa'i ngang las/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dkar po dang nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor bsam pa'i nang na/ a dkar po las 'od 'phros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma spyan drangs nas/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa la/ brgyud pa'i bla ma dang chos 'brel yod tshad thams cad thim pa'i mthar/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtshos bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bsam/ 'dir yid kyis mchod cing bstod par gsungs pas de kho nas chog kyang da lta'i gang zag phal cher la dag 'don med na rnam pa mi gsal bas de ltar na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos (162)kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pho brang nas// gsal dag bla ma gshegs su gsol// sprul pa sku yi pho brang nas// thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol// 'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li// sku dang thig le shigs se shig /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// bdag dang dbyer med brtan par bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs kyi nyams chags bshags// smin grol dbang dang gdams pa zhu// oṃ sku skye ba med pa gsal la dwangs// rdo rje'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// lus la bde bar byin gyis rlobs// āḥgasung 'gags pa med pa chos kyi sgra// ā li kā lir gsol ba 'debs// ngag la nus par byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ thugs ka dag chen po kun bzang klong*// cir mi dgongs la gsol ba 'debs/

zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes chos spyod chen mo nas 'byung ba ltar brjod/ de nas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig po// 'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs// thar pa'i lam skas chen po ste// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la// mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// dug gsum me yis gdung ba la// rang byung rlan gyis bsil bar mdzod// ma rig 'khrul pas bcings pa yi// gdos bcas lus ngag yid rnams kun// rang dengs 'od kyi rang bzhin tu// lhag med mya ngan 'das thob mdzod// bla ma sangs rgyas (163)rin po che// bdag la re sa gzhan na med// thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzod la// 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// tshe 'dir legs pa kun 'grub cing*// bgegs dang bar chad med pa dang*// 'chi khar zab mo'i 'od gsal zin// bar do'i 'phrang las sgrol bar mdzod// lus dang ngag yid brtsams pa kun// rtag tu gzhan la phan pa dang*// rkyen rnams byang chub lam mchog tu// de ring nyid nas bsgyur du gsol// bdag gis 'bad kyang thar pa dka'// mgon po khyod kyis thugs rjes grus// mgon med bdag dang 'gro ba kun// thar pa'i gling du phyin par mdzod// gang dag bdag la dad gyur tam// smod dang skur pa 'debs kyang rung*// de dag sdig byang nyon mongs med// srid pa'i chu bo spang bar shog /nam zhig bdag gi ming tsam gyis// 'gro ba'i 'dod dgu rab sgrub cing*// phyogs bcu gang ba'i zhing rnams su// mchod pa'i sprin gyis char 'bebs shog /dge ba 'di yis lus can kun// thams cad srid las rnam grol nas// ye shes dam pa gnyis thob ste// don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod// ces gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ zhabs kyi mthe bong las/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas lus phyi nang thams cad khyab pas/

lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku'i dngos grub thob/ mgrin par babs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi dngos grub thob/ snying gar babs/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ lte bar babs/ dri ma thams cad dag /(164)yon tan gyi dngos grub thob/ gsang bar babs/ phrin las kyi dngos grub thob/ bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med par gyur/ mthar mos gus kyi shugs kyis bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas dbyer med du gyur par mos la bcos bslad bral ba'i rang rig gi ngo bo ci nus bskyang ngo*// thun las ldang ba na/ rang bzhin dag pa'i dge ba 'dis// 'khor ba ngan song dong sprugs te// srid na 'ga' yang mi gnas par// thams cad sangs rgyas myur thob shog /ces sogs bsngo smon gyis mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug /thun mtshams thams cad du'ang snang grags rig gsum bla ma'i gsang ba gsum gyi ye shes su lam du khyer zhing tshogs gnyis zung 'brel gyi rnal 'byor la brtson par bya'o// 'dir rnam gzhag go don phan yon sogs spro na spyi dang mtshungs par 'chad/ tshogs bsags kyi rim pa 'di dag so sor 'bum ther la sogs pa thun du bcad de brtson skabs so so'i rjes su bsngo smon gyi rgyas gdab pa dang*/ thun mtshams su skabs de dang der 'brel ba'i lam khyer gyi gnad sogs kyang spyi ltar shes par bya'o// sngon 'gro spyir bshad pa de rnams smin gling gi khrid rgyun dkyus su 'byung ba yin cing*/ de'ang khrid tshul spyi dang mthun pa'i 'don sgom zor yang gtso bor bton par snang la/ bye brag tu bstan pa rnams ni yang tig yid bzhin nor bu las dngos su gsal ba'i thun mong ma yin par snang bas/ rje bla mas kyang 'di ltar legs zhes dngos su bkas gnang ba dang*/ rig 'dzin chen po sogs kyi khrid rgyun las kyang 'byung bar snang bas 'don sgom ma chad na dgos pa che snyam yig tshogs la ma 'dzem par dkyus su bkod pa (165)yin no// bzhi pa gsang sngags spyi mthun gyi thabs lam rlung thig gis lus sems sbyong ba la gnyis/

chags bral rlung la bslab pa dang*/ chags can thig le la slob pa'o// dang po la lnga/ rlung gi kha dog la slob pa/ dbyibs la slob pa/ grangs la slob pa/ 'gro 'ong la slob pa/ byam pa can la slob pa'o// dang po ni/ lus gnad chos bdun drangs por bsrangs la mig gnang mtho dma' bying rgod dang mthun par blta/ ngag gnad sna bug gnyis nas rlung ro dal la ring ba gsum bsal/ yid kyi gnad smin mtshams su rlung rnams 'dus pa'i ngo bo thig le dkar po yungs 'bru tsam gsal zhing 'bar ba zhig gsal btab la re dogs skyon yon dgag sgrub sogs dus gsum gyi rnam par rtog pa kun spangs te thig le'i rnam pa de kha la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la bsgom/ rnam rtog je phra ji ltar shar yang 'phro bcad la thig le'i steng du hril gyis bsgrims la 'jog /yang rig pa g.yer zhing 'phro rgod cher song na thig le'i rnam pa yid kyi yul du lam mer gsal ba la ha cang grims ma drag tsam gyis dran pa'i rgyang so bcugs la lhod kyis 'jog ste/ rang rig dang thig le so sor mi blta bar dbyer med rang gsal zhen 'dzin med pa'i ngang du skyong zhing*/ thig le'i rnam pa kho na la sems zin cing brtan par gyur pa dang*/ thig le'i mdangs 'od kyis rang gi mgo bo dang*/ de nas lus/ de nas tho phyi dang yul khams thams cad khyab/ mthar snang ba thams cad rlung gi rang bzhin dkar me re ba la shes pa gtad// yang rim gyis tshur 'dus/ smin mtshams rtsa ba'i thig le la shes pa gtad/ de ltar spro bsdu (166)res 'jog la bslab pas lus yang*/ ngag gsal/ sems gnas pa sogs rtags ma thon gyi bar du bsgom pa ni phyi ma rnams la'ang 'gre// gnyis pa ni/ sna rtser rlung gi thig le dkar sngo che chung bod sran tsam pa zhig gsal btab/ de gsal ba dang sna bug gi rlung 'gro 'ong dal ba la brten nas rlung phyir dbyung tshe thig le de rlung dang 'grogs nas skya yer gyi song*/

nang du 'jug tshe rlung dang lhan cig byung ba sna rtser grang bsil gyis gnas par bsam/ de yang lus grang shas che na thig le kha dog dmar po reg bya tsha bar bsgom/ yang na mdzod pur bsgoms kyang chog gsungs// gsum pa ni/ rlung dang shes pa 'gro ldog gcig tu byas te/ rgyun gyi dbugs 'byung 'jug gnas gsum po 'di dag rang bab tu bgrang ba la shes pa rtse gcig tu gtad de khug pa re la gcig tu brtsis pa'i grangs ma yengs par bzung*/ rim gyis rgyu ba je dal je ring la gtang nas mthar yun ring du gnas pa ma byung gi bar du sbyang ngo*// bzhi pa ni/ rang lus stong chen sgrib thogs dang bral ba'i lte bar thod pa phyi dkar la nang dmar ba dpral ba mdun phyogs su bstan pa zhig gsal gdab/ de'i nang du rlung gi rdo rje sngon po gyen langs nas 'bras tsam pa la sems gtad nas ci nus bsgom/ de la gsal brtan gyi nyams skyes pa na sna sgo'i rlung 'gro 'ong dang bstun nas/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe rdo rje sna bug g.yas nas sngo rgyang gi song*/ tshur 'ong ba na g.yon nas zhugs te thod par gnas par bsam zhing lus sems bde phril phril ba la blo bzhag /goms nas sems gnas je brtan du song rim bzhin rdo rje phyir 'gro ba'i tshad je thung du btang*/ mthar sna rtse'i sor bcu drug gi tshad tsam (167)tsam du 'gro 'ong byed par bsam/ lnga pa ni/ snga ma goms pa dang dmigs pa'i gzhi sngar gyi 'gro 'ong de ka lan kha shas byas rjes rlung phra la ring ba zhig 'phangs pas rdo rje sna bug g.yas kyi lam nas rgyang ring por song bar bsam la rlung phyir mnan/ de nas rlung nang du shar gyis drangs pas rdo rje sna bug g.yon nas zhugs/ lte ba'i thod pa la sib kyi thim par bsam la bum can g.yo med kha sbyor du 'ching*/ de'i tshe thod pa yang zhu nas ha yig dmar po'i rnam par gyur pa la blo bzhag ste rlung dang lus thams cad na bun yal ba ltar bun long du gyur par bsam la/

bum pa can gyi rlung sbyor ba bzhi ldan drag tu dgong*/ rlung gtong ba'i tshe rlung sems nam mkha' dang bsres nas mi rtog pa'i ngang du bzhag /gong du bum can 'byongs zin pa yin na 'dir ci nus re bsgom pas chog go /de min rab 'bring tha ma gang rung ma 'grub kyi bar du sbyong zhing de'ang thog mar ha cang ma drags pa'i ran par bzung na gegs chung ba yin no// lus gnad dang rlung ro bsal ba ni spyi gnad yin pas gong smos ltar thams cad la sbyor ro// gnyis pa chags can thig le'i rnal 'byor la bslab pa la/ dngos rig ma la brten nas lus gyi bde ba la slob pa ni lag tu mi lon pas khrid rgyun dkyus la mi 'byung zhing*/ de'i tshul bde stong bdud rtsi'i sprin phung sogs su gsal ba ltar ro// rjes mthun rlung thig gi bde ba la slob pa ni/ lus gnad rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa khu tshur kha sbub/ pus mo'i brla steng du bzhag la lag ngar bsrang*/ mig thad kar cher re mig 'bras mi bsgyur zhing rdzi ma mi brdeg /sems gnad rang lus stong gsal phru ma phus btab pa ltar gyur pa'i dbus su/ rtsa dbu ma sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po (168)po tsam pa/ kha dog dmar skya'am phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yid yul du gsal gang bde ba zhig bsgoms la/ de yang yar sna tshangs bu ga dang mar sna lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang zhing til gyi mar me bzhin du gsal ba rang 'od 'phro ba/ pad+ma'i snal ma ltar shin tu srab pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo dang g.yon du rkyang ma dkar po dbu ma las ldab 'gyur gyis phra ba/ yar sna smin mtshams kyi thad nas gugs te sna bug g.yas g.yon du zug zug cing mas sna gnyis dbu ma'i mas snar tshud pa/ de ltar rtsa gsum sum gshibs su thal gyi yod pa las 'khor lo bzhi'i mtshams rnams su ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma la thim pa'i tshul gyis nang khongs 'brel bar gnas pa/

de las gyes pa'i 'khor lo bzhi bsgom ste/ de yang dbu ma'i yar sne las rtse sor gnyis gzhal ba'i mtshams na rtse mo rnam par bkod pa'i 'khor lo// mgrin pa'i phrag pa skyes mtshams nas ro rnams 'dus pa'i 'khor lo// snying ga'i nu phrag gi thad nas dran pa 'dus pa'i 'khor lo// lte khung gi thad nas skye byed kyi 'khor lo ste/ thams cad kyang kha dog dmar skya dwangs gsal sbubs stong gi rnam pa gsal bar bsgom mo// de nas spyi bo'i rtse mo rnam bkod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su thig le stong pa'i sgron ma kha dog dkar la snum zhing 'dril ba sran ma tsam zhig gsal btab nas de nyid la sems rtse gcig tu gtad la bsgom/ de la sems zin pa na rlung ro lan gsum bsal la steng rlung nar gyis rngub/ lte bar bsgyur stabs su mnan cing 'og rlung drag tu bskums pas thig le de nyid 'dar phri li li byed pa dang*/ de las byang sems bde ba'i rgyun sran chung tsam gcig rjes gcig non du bde phri li li babs pa'am/ yang na ba thag lta bu na ra ra (169)babs pa gang bde byas la spyi bo// mgrin pa/ snying ga /lte ba'i 'khor lo bzhi rim par gang bas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes par bsam/ thig le gsang bar brtan par gyur pas dngos po lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam zhing*/ de re re'i ngang mdangs bskyangs la bum can ci nus bzung bas bde ba je rgyas su song*/ lus sems bde bas khyab/ slar yang gyen du rim gyis drangs pas mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi nyams su myong*/ spyi bo'i thig le la sib sib thim zhing brtan par gyur pas rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam la de'i ngang mdangs ci nus bskyang*/ mthar thig le de je chung je phrar gyur te mi dmigs spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du ci nus su 'jog /bde stong zung 'jug rang rig rang gsal de nyid thun mtshams rnams su yang bskyang ci thub bya/

'dir lte bar a thung mi bsgom pa ni man ngag gi byang bar yin cing*/ bde stong bdud rtsi'i sprin phung gi rang lus sbyong skabs lte ba'i a thung bsgom par yang gsungs pas bde drod skye dka' ba'i rigs la de ltar yang legs par mngon no// de ltar 'bad pas lus sems bde stong du 'gro zhing rlung thig las su rung bas 'byung ba lnga la thogs pa med/ zas skom gyi sred pa las grol sems la rang dbang thob/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i bsam gtan gyi rim pa dpag tu med pa'i yon tan mtha' yas pa dag kyang thob par 'gyur ro// de ltar chags bral rlung gi rnal 'byor dang*/ chags can thig le'i rnal 'byor ni lam gzhan las rlung 'byongs pa'i gang zag la ma bshad kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur zhing*/ kun mkhyen chen po'i don (170)khrid du'ang ma gsungs pas rtsa rlung mi chun pa'i gang zag la'ang ma bstan kyang chog par mngon no// lnga pa dran pa rgyun gcod kyi man ngag gis 'byung ba lnga rang sar dengs par byed pa'i gnad bstan pa la gnyis/ a lnga skyem kyi don nyams su len pa/ 'byung 'khrugs byings rgod kyi gegs sel ba'o// dang po ni/ 'byung bzhi zad pa'i rgyud chen nam mkha' la// 'khrul gzhi zad pa'i rig pa rgod yan de// sna tshogs khyab brdal chen po'i khang bzang du// 'dzin byed dran pa zad pa'i lcags kyu yis// gsal byed steng 'og med pa'i snying nang ni// ma yengs bsam pa zad pa'i tshul gyis bzung*// zhes 'byung bas/ a lnga'i don skye ba med par nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam nas lus gnad rnam snang chos bdun bca'/ rlung kha nas drangs te dal bus phyir btang*/ dal bus nang du rngubs la rtsol ba lhod pa'i ngang cung zad 'then la/ snying gar nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i ngo
